title: New Mexico Statutes Annotated 1978, Chapter 10 (Public Officers and Employees), Article 11 - Retirement of Public Officers and Employees Generally (the Public Employees Retirement Act)
verified_how: Fetched the NM OneSource chapter page (item 4364, '?iframe=true' form) in a browser on 23 September 2026: page title 'Chapter 10 - Public Officers and Employees - NMOneSource.com', collection 'Current New Mexico Statutes Annotated 1978', date 2026; the table of contents lists 'ARTICLE 11 Retirement of Public Officers and Employees Generally' with no repeal marker, immediately followed by 'ARTICLE 12 Judicial Retirement (Repealed.)' - so repealed articles are marked and this one is not.
notes: Contributory old-age insurance for the general population is federal (Social Security Act, 42 U.S.C. ch. 7), so the in-scope state statute is the public-employee pension scheme: the Public Employees Retirement Act administered by PERA. Related statutes in the same chapter are Article 7A (Deferred Compensation) and Article 7C (Retiree Health Care); the separate Educational Retirement Act sits in ch. 22. New Mexico's other contributory social-insurance statute is the Unemployment Compensation Law, NMSA 1978 ch. 51, art. 1.
